title: Satin crossings of 30 mm are not split
description: A 40 x 30 mm rectangle sewn as satin across the 30 mm (Direction 90 degrees), density 4.5, under sewing off: PE-DESIGN keeps the 30 mm crossings whole (209 needle points, every stitch 30 mm): no split. OpenStitch splits satin stitches over 12 mm, so the reference pins what PE-DESIGN sends to the machine.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference machine/machine-satin-width-30.pes (pe-refs-3, 2026-10-28): 211 stitches, longest 30.0 mm

references.make: On a 100 x 100 mm Design Page draw (or import) a 40 x 30 mm rectangle from (10, 10) mm. Line Not Sewn; region Satin Stitch, Direction Manual straight line 90 degrees, Density 4.5, Under sewing off, Pull compensation 0.0. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN's crossings reach across the whole column
